question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw.clawFeed.v1` and `openclaw claws feed inspect/plan` as the next core Claws contract while the base manifest PR is still open?
rationale: The branch is technically plausible after the source-boundary fix, but it defines public schema, CLI, and trust metadata that automation cannot approve as product direction.

options.title: Continue after proof and contract approval
options.body: Keep this PR open, require real CLI output, and have a maintainer approve the feed schema, command names, and trust fields before merge.

options.title: Hold until the base PR lands
options.body: Pause this draft until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328 establishes the first Claws manifest baseline.

options.title: Decline the core feed surface for now
options.body: Close or redirect the feed layer if maintainers want ClawHub/plugin surfaces to own this before core grows a new schema.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and contract approval
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require real CLI output, and have a maintainer approve the feed schema, command names, and trust fields before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main routing signal is recent ownership of the CLI descriptor and command-registry surface this PR extends.
